newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes firmer at 487-489 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes firmer at 487-489 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 487-489 per dollar in thin volume, up from the 490-510 morning spread as dollar supply topped demand in calm interbank trade and the central bank was seen buying dollars, dealers said.
"Some final clients were selling foreign currency to meet pending lev payments amid low dollar demand, which helped the lev gain some ground," one dealer said.
The central bank was seen buying dollars at 487-487.50 levs in a bid to boost its foreign exchange reserves, traders said.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.
Central bank forex reserves stood at $525 million at the end of November, doun from around $541 million a month earlier. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-876032
